The graph of a system of linear equations is shown. What is the solution $(x, y)$ to the system?
explanation: Choice C is correct. The solution to a system of linear equations is the point of intersection of the two lines. From the graph, the two lines intersect at $x = 2$ and $y = -2$, so the solution $\left(x, y\right)$ to the system is $\left(2, -2\right)$.
